function.name: conversationdirector
function.description: Decide whether to respond to new conversation, share a fact, or make an occasional brief check-in during a quiet spell.

response_type.description: Pick 'respond' for new user conversation that warrants input, 'fact' for a fact, or 'anybody_there' for an occasional quiet-chat check-in. Do not repeat replies or check-ins without new input.
